findings: The candidate protocol is opt-in. Ordinary send behavior is unchanged, while bounded send records propagation exhaustion and preserves pending activity as naturally non-quiescent evidence.
Causal-origin factorization produced one deterministic effect in the unrelated two-origin fixture with input-order behavioral equality, exact replay, and natural quiescence.
The same-origin mixed-owner control produced one motor output without activating factorization, proving that a shared carried-origin label can launder evidence across private learner paths.

The bounded unchanged hand improved from three to eight changed steps and ended at position four, but first exhausted propagation at step eight with 88 motor candidates and failed natural quiescence, closure, and perturbation recovery.
The one-shot campaign correctly falsified the hand candidate rather than promoting movement, and its convergence retires raw carried-origin identity as sufficient ownership authority.
All 46 non-ignored core tests, 11 hand-adapter tests, and four origin experiment tests pass; the representative warm regression suite completed in 0.46 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: The implementation and negative evidence are supported, but causal-origin-first factorization is not adopted physics and is refuted as a sufficient hand solve.
The exact repeated target-origin-owner cycle behind the step-eight runaway has not yet been localized.
A successor diagnostic must observe carried origin and actual completing-path owner together before any new ownership or re-entry law is admissible.
